tailBindNote: The direction of each tail bone in the seated bind (bind_turns() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), as in the source: the root goes back and a little down over the back edge of the seat, and the tip turns up behind the seat.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature). The half width holds the haunch (x -0.153 to 0.153).

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the eyeball of each side: a loose dome of 37 vertices and 36 faces, open at its rim (x 0.016 to 0.071, y 0.871 to 0.930, z 0.116 to 0.146 in the source, a sphere of radius 0.0332 about (0.0383, 0.8997, 0.1132)). The map paints the iris, the pupil, and a light on each dome. The nose box holds the dark brown nose (x -0.032 to 0.032, y 0.816 to 0.868, the front at z 0.261).
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H (0.276014 units) is 0.41623 m, 1.27 times the H of the dog of main (assets/models/dog/dog.rig.glb at cbc8db5e4), so that the beagle reads a little larger than the Tripo cat of the violas. In the seated bind, the top of its head stands 1.12 times as high as the top of the head of the cat, and its standing height is 1.09 times the height of the cat to the top of its head. The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale. The head, the trunk, the arms, the legs, the feet, and the ears keep the form of the source. The front paws are smaller than in the source (the edit paw of the build: 0.82 times as long and 0.8 times as wide past the wrist joint).
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the head, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (closed rings of 13 vertices at x 0.121 to 0.182 and 0.281 to 0.303, axis y 0.647 to 0.633, radius 0.055 to 0.039; from x 0.201 to 0.246 the rings run through 2 poles in front): the shoulder joint at x 0.10, at the trunk side (x 0.103 at y 0.64), the elbow at x 0.205, at the middle from the shoulder to the wrist, the wrist at x 0.31, where the paw widens, the knuckles at x 0.375, where the digits part, the tip at x 0.428. Leg (rings about each 0.015 to 0.02 units from y 0.06 to y 0.30): the hip joint at (0.083, 0.28, 0.035) in the haunch, the knee at y 0.16, at the back notch of the leg, the ankle at y 0.055, the ball of the foot at z 0.07, and the toe tips at z 0.13. Trunk: the spine bones lie at about 0.35 of the depth from the back. The neck is narrowest at y 0.60 to 0.62, and the chin is at y 0.74. Ears: the root at (0.11, 0.91, 0), the tips hang down to (0.165, 0.73, 0.04), near the top of each shoulder. Tail: joined to the haunch, from its root at (0, 0.34, -0.085) back and down to its low bend at (0, 0.30, -0.17), then up to its tip at (0, 0.47, -0.235). The palm is the true palm of the source: the mean normal of the paw faces that face down (x from 0.32) is (0.155, -0.988, -0.012). The paw turn of the build turns it with the paw. The hip joint lies 0.035 forward, so that the thigh slopes 16 degrees from the vertical in the rest: a thigh nearer to the vertical gives a bone frame that the export refuses (it scales by more than 1e-5). The edit paw of the build moves the knuckle joint and the tip of each fingers bone with the paw: the config holds the mapped places.

headScale.note: The build scales the head, the ears, the eyeballs, the nose, and the muzzle about the neck joint by the factor, with the head weight as the share (scale_head() of build.py).
